gold: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis

selector.rationale: Hidradenoma papilliferum best explains the clinical and histopathological findings, including the presence of a well-defined erythematous plaque with overlying ulceration, a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining, and papillary projections with atypical cells.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and limited support from candidate notes

rejected.label: Syringocystadenoma papilliferum
rejected.why: Limited support from candidate notes and less specific findings

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Although some atypical cells and mitotic figures are present, the lack of dermal invasion and the overall architecture of the tumor favor Hidradenoma papilliferum
